John, the presbyter, friend of Papias, 170 (note 4), 171,

261; placed among the Antilegomena, 156.
Julian I., Gentile bishop of Jerusalem, 226.
Julian II., Gentile bishop of Jerusalem, 226.

Justin, apology of, quoted, 114, 158, 180, 181, 184, 185,
193, 195, 196, 223; work against Marcion, 184; against heresies, 185; martyrdom

κλήρογ, used in the

Liberty, full religious, granted by Constantine and

Marcus Aurelius, 106, 185, 186, 188, 196, 197, 205, 210,
